result.title: PN-Mix: Pair-Norm Guided Mixed-Precision Key Cache Quantization for Efficient Long-Output LLM Inference
result.summary: Long-output inference in large language models suffers from severe KV cache memory and bandwidth bottlenecks. While KV cache quantization alleviates this issue, low-bit quantization (e.g., 2-bit) severely degrades model accuracy. Recent mixed-precision key-cache quantization methods mitigate this degradation by allocating higher precision to important key channels, but estimate channel saliency using only key statistics. Through attention logit perturbation analysis at the RoPE channel-pair level, we show that quantization errors in channel pairs with large query--key pair-norm products contribute significantly to logit variation. Based on this insight, we propose PN-Mix, a mixed-precision key-cache quantization method for RoPE-based decoder-only LLMs, which allocates higher precision to salient channel pairs identified once during the prefill stage and reused throughout decoding. Across standard reasoning, code-generation, and AIME benchmarks, PN-Mix with 2.26-bit average precision achieves comparable or better average accuracy than prior mixed-precision methods using 2.32--2.39 bits. Furthermore, in our Pareto sweep, PN-Mix degrades gracefully down to 1.5 bits, whereas the compared baselines exhibit sharper performance drops below 2.25 bits.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 PN-Mix，依据 RoPE 通道对上 query–key 对范数乘积估计显著性，在 prefill 阶段一次性确定通道对精度分配，用于长输出 LLM 推理的混合精度 key cache 量化。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作属纯文本推理的 KV cache 低比特量化与效率优化，虽涉及注意力结构与缓存，但目标是数值压缩精度分配，未触及视觉/多模态推理状态、证据筛选或停止决策，与 LVR 主线缺乏具体可迁移线索，故排除。
